name: Effect headline
for: The one display line on a page (hero or closing call to action) where a key phrase, or the whole line, is filled with a still effect while the rest stays in ink.
how: fill(): one still canvas over the headline (speed 0), blended so only the glyphs of the [data-fill] phrase show it; the real text stays selectable. Still, so it needs no pause button.
rules: Fill a phrase of two or three words, or one short line; never body text.
Display size only: 40px and up, weight 500 or more.
Never fluted-glass in type: on a colour ground it paints thick accent bars through the letters.
a11y: The text stays real and is read normally; the overlay is aria-hidden. Forced colours and no-script show the plain ink. Reduced motion shows one still frame.
